links.outcome: GPT-4V detection of ICD-10 findings on real-world chest radiographs versus radiologist reference standard
links.effect: Zero-shot ICD-10 detection: NIH PPV 12.3%, TPR 5.8%, F1 7.3%; MIDRC PPV 25.0%, TPR 16.8%, F1 18.2%. With laterality, F1 was 4.5% (NIH) and 6.4% (MIDRC).
links.quote: Although GPT-4V has shown promise in understanding natural images, it had limited effectiveness in interpreting real-world chest radiographs.

unlisted_practices: Few-shot prompting (two examples) to improve generative model performance on chest radiograph findings

screen.reason: Evaluates the diagnostic accuracy and image-text generation of GPT-4V on chest radiographs using zero-shot and few-shot benchmarking against radiologist reference standards without testing deployment safeguards or human-AI interaction.
